input_admission.all_numeric_bridge_inputs: Assumed. Source shares refer to a hypothetical fungible component basket, NOT CCC spending shares or national physical shares.
input_admission.source_prices: Assumed fixed delivered, equivalent-quality prices. Existing retail snapshots do not establish this basket or a recycled discount.
input_admission.recycler_price_transmission_weight: Assumed reduced-form influence on marginal auction prices, NOT recycler buyer share, domestic share, or winning-bid share.
input_admission.donor_contribution: Expected net parts contribution after variable fulfillment costs, before donor acquisition. Exposure applies only to the eligible collision basket; mechanical parts, scrap and other demand are held constant.
input_admission.supply_price_response: Assumed fractional price support per log decline in total-loss supply; zero and 0.5 tested. Not estimated equilibrium elasticity.
input_admission.threshold_responsive_fraction: Mixture of claims following the inherited switching rule and otherwise identical claims whose disposition remains at reference. It attenuates an unvalidated derivative without refitting historical levels.
input_admission.expected_salvage_pass_through: Scenario share of price shock reflected in insurer expected salvage; timing is unobserved.
input_admission.period_and_population: Uniform full-year incremental US insurance shock. International, other US and purchased revenue remain at reference; no global extension inferred. All figures are counterfactual differences, not proof of outright year-over-year deflation.
